title: Police Blotter: 1 booked on misdemeanor charges in Webb County
excerpt: Police Blotter: 1 booked on misdemeanor charges in Webb County
content:
LAREDO, Texas — One person was booked into the Webb County Jail overnight on alleged misdemeanor charges, according to public booking records.

JOSHUA COLE WOJCIECHOWSKI — Wojciechowski (booking #202608921) was arrested Wednesday at 2:54 a.m. on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. His listed city is Corpus Christi, Texas 78418. The arresting agency was not listed in the public booking record. Case number PFCC26-003321L1.

All charges are allegations. Wojciechowski is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, Webb Watch 956
